children: Moshe Arkin disclosed a 33.34% beneficial stake in Odysight.ai Inc. through a Schedule 13D filing. The filing, dated September 9, 2026, follows additional purchases over the past year, shifting his status from a passive 13G to an active 13D. The move highlights Arkin’s growing influence at the company, where he also serves as a director.

Arkin filed the 13D to reflect recent purchases and states he will evaluate Odysight.ai’s performance and prospects over time. He “may purchase additional equity” or “dispose of some or all” of his holdings in various types of transactions, subject to laws, and currently has no specific plans for corporate actions.

He keeps options open based on the company’s business outlook, stock price, market conditions, and other opportunities. Beyond this flexible stance, he discloses no plans for changes to control, governance, or capital structure.

Moshe Arkin is an Israeli investor and Chairman of Arkin Holdings Ltd., with a long history in healthcare and life sciences investing. He also controls M. Arkin (1999) Ltd., which manages private capital across multiple asset classes. Arkin is known for concentrated, long-term positions and active board engagement in select portfolio companies.
